requirement: Provide a pytest factory fixture that creates accounts with generated or explicit names, remembers only the ones it created successfully, and deletes them newest first when the test finishes, skipping any the test already removed.
skeleton: AccountStore with validated create and recorded delete, a store fixture, and a make_account generator fixture holding a per-test created list and counter, yielding a factory, then deleting in reverse with a presence check.
caption: A pytest factory fixture that creates test accounts on demand and cleans every one of them up in teardown. AccountStore keeps accounts in a dict from id to name, hands out increasing ids from 1, records each deleted id in a deleted list, raises ValueError when a name is blank after strip or duplicates an existing name, and raises LookupError when deleting an unknown id. The store fixture, registered with pytest.fixture under the name store, returns a fresh AccountStore. make_account(store) is a generator fixture: it keeps a list of created ids and an itertools.count starting at 1, both local to the fixture call so every test starts over, and yields factory(name=None). The factory uses the given name, or user-N from the counter only when the name is None, so an empty string still reaches validation; an id is recorded only after create succeeds. After the yield, teardown walks the created ids in reverse so the newest account is deleted first, skipping any id the test already deleted itself. The fixture asserts, against a module-scoped store the test module overrides, that generated names are user-1 and user-2, that the next test sees an empty store with deletions in the order 2 then 1 and names restarting at user-1, that duplicate, whitespace-only and empty names raise ValueError without being cleaned up, and that a manually deleted account is skipped while the rest are removed.

plan.intent: Create test data on demand and always clean it up
constraints: Generated names restart at user-1 in every test
Accounts are deleted newest first after each test
Failed creations are never recorded for cleanup
Accounts the test deleted itself are skipped
Blank and duplicate names raise ValueError
Deleting an unknown id raises LookupError

rationale.teaches: The factory-as-fixture pattern: a yield fixture returning a closure that records what it made, with per-test state and reverse-order teardown.
rationale.why: Factories that skip teardown, clean up in creation order or keep counters at module level pass each test alone and break only when the next test inherits their state.

ops.docstring: A factory fixture that creates accounts on demand and deletes them afterwards.

candidates.why_wrong: Teardown deletes accounts in creation order instead of newest first.
Nothing runs after the yield, so every created account leaks into later tests.
The name counter lives at module level, so generated names keep counting across tests.
Blank and whitespace-only names are stored instead of raising ValueError.
An empty name is treated like no name and silently replaced by a generated one.
